descartes.comment: Java-based MCP TCP adapter (drop-in replacement for Node.js adapter)

_readme.description: Example configuration for Claude Code using the pure-Java MCP adapter
requirements: Descartes MCP server running on localhost:9080
Update 'command' path to absolute path to run-mcp-adapter.sh
advantages: Same features as Node.js adapter (reconnection, queueing, timeouts)
trade_offs: Slightly higher memory usage (~50-100MB vs ~30-50MB for Node.js)
Slower startup due to JVM initialization
Requires JAR build step (auto-handled by run-mcp-adapter.sh)

alternative_direct_java.description: You can also invoke Java directly without the wrapper script
alternative_direct_java.note: Using run-mcp-adapter.sh is recommended as it auto-builds the JAR if missing

all_environment_variables.MCP_RECONNECT_MIN_DELAY: Minimum reconnection delay in ms (default: 500, range: 50-300000)
all_environment_variables.MCP_RECONNECT_MAX_DELAY: Maximum reconnection delay with exponential backoff in ms (default: 5000, range: 50-300000)
all_environment_variables.MCP_MESSAGE_QUEUE_SIZE: Maximum queued messages while disconnected (default: 100, range: 1-10000)
all_environment_variables.MCP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT: Request timeout duration in ms (default: 30000, range: 1000-600000)
all_environment_variables.MCP_TCP_KEEP_ALIVE: TCP keep-alive interval in ms (default: 10000, range: 1000-600000)
all_environment_variables.MCP_LOG_RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW: Rate limiting time window in ms (default: 60000)
all_environment_variables.MCP_MAX_MESSAGE_SIZE: Maximum message size in bytes (default: 10485760 = 10MB, range: 1024-104857600)

_readme.see_also: For Node.js adapter configuration, see mcpservers.json
